# npm and pnpm: route the scope to this feed (.npmrc)
# Only @polaris-key packages are looked up here; every other package stays on its usual registry.
@polaris-key:registry=https://pkg.plrs.im/npm/polaris-key/

# Yarn Berry (.yarnrc.yml)
npmScopes:
  polaris-key:
    npmRegistryServer: "https://pkg.plrs.im/npm/polaris-key/"

# Bun (bunfig.toml)
[install.scopes]
"@polaris-key" = "https://pkg.plrs.im/npm/polaris-key/"

# Install
npm install @polaris-key/node@0.9.0
